purpose: no-teacher CE-only floor: does teacher supervision buy anything over ordinary training?
only_intended_scientific_change: objective: layer_kd (raw residual-transition KD) -> sft (CE only)
config_construction: kd_run.build_config() applied to run008.command(); objective overridden to 'sft'
loss: HF causal-LM cross-entropy via model(input_ids=batch, labels=batch).loss
enforced_by: trainer._require_supported raises if objective=='sft' and a teacher provider is passed; train() is called with teacher=None
recorded_implementation_differences: no 4-bit teacher resident -> peak VRAM necessarily much lower (inherent to the control)
kd_weight/kd_temperature/kd_top_k/layer_kd_* carried for provenance but inert under sft
config.teacher metadata retained only to record which tokenizer produced the packed stream

preregistered_interpretation.if_ce_only_much_worse_than_all_kd_arms: teacher supervision is buying real signal
preregistered_interpretation.if_ce_only_comparable_to_kd_arms: teacher supervision is NOT buying much at this budget; the whole KD comparison loses significance and must be reported as such
preregistered_interpretation.if_ce_only_better: report as-is; do not rescue the KD arms
